contract: A successful Native Join inserts the member, enqueues RoomRoster using nonblocking Outbound::try_send, then sends its oneshot JoinReply. With a fresh capacity-8 receiver in this test, the first outbound is its single connected Player seat. Snapshot is projected using the connection-bound member. No production behavior changes are needed.
timeout: new 3-second roster receive bound; existing timing thresholds unchanged
callers: Only nc09_native_actor_join_command_snapshot changes; existing actor/module imports, configured join/reconnect helper, receipt and lazy reclamation tests remain unchanged.
